excerpt: The Power of Proactive Sourcing: How to Fill Hard-to-Hire Roles Ahead of Demand Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Staffing shortages have become a serious challenge for hospitality businesses around the world. From restaurants and hotels to event venues and resorts, many employers are struggling to find and retain qualified workers. In an industry where customer satisfaction hinges on speed, service, and skilled staff, being short-staffed can lead to lost revenue, low morale, and poor reviews. This is where working with a recruitment agency can make a significant difference.
